operations.command: cd /etc/nixos && git -c user.name=recovery-test -c user.email=test@test commit --allow-empty -m 'RECOVERY-TEST-MARKER' >/dev/null && git rev-parse --short HEAD > /tmp/marker.sha && head -c 7 /tmp/marker.sha | head -c 1
chmod +x /tmp/migrate.sh && /tmp/migrate.sh --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -q 'DRY-RUN MODE' && /tmp/migrate.sh --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -q 'DRY  rsync' && printf dry-ok

DEV=$(findmnt -no SOURCE / | sed 's/\[.*//') && mkdir -p /mnt/check-root && mount -t btrfs -o subvol=@root "$DEV" /mnt/check-root && marker=$(cat /tmp/marker.sha) && cd /mnt/check-root/etc/nixos && git log --oneline -5 | grep -q "$marker" && umount /mnt/check-root && rmdir /mnt/check-root && printf marker-now-in-@root

DEV=$(findmnt -no SOURCE / | sed 's/\[.*//') && mkdir -p /mnt/check-root && mount -t btrfs -o subvol=@root "$DEV" /mnt/check-root && test -f /mnt/check-root/etc/nixos/secrets/hashed_password.txt && umount /mnt/check-root && rmdir /mnt/check-root && printf secrets-preserved
